title: Suspicions UID/GID confusion in DefineCreateFlags
body: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/7ea8b6c2c049d4762b2f52b489b31662a81410fe/cmd/podman/common/create.go#L758-L772 has the GID flag setting an UID field, and vice versa.

comments.body: Hi! I took a look at the issue and the UID/GID fields in `DefineCreateFlags` appear to be swapped as described. I’d be interested in working on this. Is the current assignee already working on it, or would it be okay for me to submit a PR?
